strategy.summary: Buy a sharp dip and sell when the price snaps back. Each bar the strategy measures how far the close sits below its moving average, in units of recent volatility (a z-score). When that z-score falls to the entry level it buys at the next bar's open, and it sells once the z-score recovers to the exit level, after a maximum number of bars, or at an optional stop.
strategy.formula: z = (close − average of the last N closes) ÷ standard deviation of the last M closes

rules.label: Buy
rules.text: When z closes at or below the entry level (−1.5 to −3). With confirmation on, the signal bar must also close above the previous bar's close. The order fills at the next bar's open.

rules.label: Sell
rules.text: At the next open after z closes at or above the exit level, or once the position has been held the max number of bars. An optional stop sits k × ATR(14) below the entry and fills the moment it is touched.

rules.label: Size
rules.text: Long only, one position at a time. As many whole ES contracts as the account covers at full contract value (no leverage), starting from $1,000,000.

funnel.name: Start
funnel.why: All 41,472 versions backtested once on 2018–2022 data.

funnel.name: 1 · Integrity
funnel.why: Per-trade checks for look-ahead and impossible fills on every version, plus 40 random versions re-run on cut-off data. 0 failed.

funnel.name: 2 · Enough trades
funnel.why: Needs ≥100 completed trades and ≥10 a year in ≥4 of the 5 years. Removed 12,046 (864 on 5min, 2,644 on 15min, 8,538 on 1h).

funnel.name: 3 · Profit
funnel.why: Needs a net profit, Sharpe ≥ 0.75 and drawdown no worse than 30%. Removed 29,338 (12,960 on 5min, 11,144 on 15min, 5,234 on 1h); 25,363 of them lost money.

funnel.name: 4 · Stable settings
funnel.why: Each setting is nudged one at a time, down and up: average length, volatility length and max hold by ±20% (rounded), entry and exit z by ±0.25, a numeric ATR stop by ±0.25. At least 70% of the 10–12 nudged versions must be profitable, with median Sharpe ≥ 0.5. Removed 8.

funnel.name: 6 · Remove duplicates
funnel.why: Versions whose monthly returns correlate ≥ 0.8 form a group; the best 2 of each go on (a group of one keeps its one). 80 versions formed 26 groups.

funnel.name: 8 · Validation
funnel.why: Frozen finalists run once on unseen data: needs net > 0, Sharpe ≥ 0.3, drawdown no worse than 30% and ≥40 trades.

luck.method: Random long trades at uniformly random bars in the validation window, each held a random 3-10 bars and exited at the open, no overlap, covering the target share of bars. Same fills, slippage, commission and whole-contract sizing as the strategy; scored with the same daily-Sharpe and time-in-market code.

assumptions: Data: Databento CME continuous front month (ES.v.0), 1-minute bars aggregated to 5/15/60 minutes. Rolls are back-adjusted so the roll gap is not treated as a price move.
Day session only: NYSE regular session 09:30-16:00 NY on NYSE trading days (ending no later than the NYSE close). Overnight Globex trading is not used; positions can be held overnight.
Costs: 1 tick slippage per side and $2.50 commission per contract per side. Positions that span a roll are assumed to roll for free.
Lengths and holding periods are counted in bars of the chosen bar size.
Sharpe uses daily mark-to-market returns (√252), with idle cash earning 0%. Time in market is the share of bars with an open position.
Holdout (2025 onward) has not been run. It is a one-time final test and needs an explicit go-ahead.
